verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's experiment-results docs describe a choice between its Bayesian and Frequentist engines, with Chance to Win and statistical health checks, and its GitHub README lists CUPED, post-stratification, sequential testing and SRM checks. That covers both engine options and variance reduction. Community comments questioning early-stopping detail and significance alerts are general skepticism, not concrete contradictions. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the CUPED/post-stratification methodology and configuration (only a README bullet in the pack), and independent hands-on corroboration of how the stats engine performs.
